causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: A planned network outage impacted the Heywood interconnector and reduced South Australia's access to cheaper generation from Victoria.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Constraints managing the outage limited imports over Heywood to around 45 MW during the high-priced intervals, out of its nominal capacity of 600 MW.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Low output from wind generation in South Australia reduced the amount of low-priced capacity available.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding of capacity for both technical and commercial reasons contributed to the high price.

causes.quote: Ramp rate limitations on some generating units prevented capacity below $5,000 per MWh being dispatched in time.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: On 28 December, CS Energy's Gladstone unit 2 went on a planned outage to rectify a tube leak which had been limiting its available capacity to 140 MW, half of its registered capacity.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: At 4.12 pm, Gladstone unit 1 tripped while attempting to come online after a month-long outage.

causes.label: battery_state_of_charge
causes.quote: Bouldercombe battery in Queensland shifted 20 MW of capacity from a low price to $10,389 per MWh, due to a change in its state of charge.

interconnectors_named.name: Queensland to NSW interconnector (QNI)
interconnectors_named.quote: During the high-priced periods, the Queensland to NSW interconnector (QNI) was importing an average of 323 MW into Queensland on 28 December and an average of 449 MW on 29 December, out of a northbound capacity of 700 MW.
